nom: COSRX The 6 Peptide Skin Booster Serum with Niacinamide & Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I wanted to love this product to support with skin tone and fine lines but I couldn't even give it a full week because it was breaking me out so bad. Every day I'd wake up with 2-3 new blemishes. Chin. Forehead. Mouth. Hairline. I stopped after 5 days. The day after I removed this product things calmed down. My skin is not acne prone so while i love seeing the reviews of this working for others, especially acne prone girlies it is unfortunately… not compatible with my skin type. I may just go for Skinceuticals P-TIOX next, as it's a TikTok derm fav for fine lines.

This has become a staple in my skincare routine. I'm VERY acne prone, and it hasn't caused a single breakout. My husband even started using it, too! I've had my first one for over 6 months and am just now repurchasing. If I were the only one using it, I honestly think it would last well over a year. Highly recommend!
I bought this entire line of products and I have to say my skin has never been more hydrated or Glass like in my life
The formula seems to be working well and the price point is excellent

For context I have combination acne-prone skin with mild anti aging concerns and I'm also a licensed esthi. This serum is something I found kinda boring at first but as I've used it (for about 6 months now) I've realized it's my favorite serum. When I first got it I had a couple other serums to compare it to (some thicker hyaluronic ones) and this one is not as moisturizing as the others BUT its watery texture makes it fantastic for layering. The other serums would sometimes over-occlude my skin but this one my skin "drinks up". I can use this twice a day with no issues, and it's especially refreshing in the summertime and very humid weather. It addresses both anti-aging concerns and oil/inflammation concerns, which are hard to balance at the same time. It's the perfect sweet spot for me and it helps me customize my hydration level depending on where my skin is at. Strongly recommend!
Only been using this product for 1 wk....goes on easily and softens fine lines.
Everytime I try this it breaks me out in acne. And i never have acne problems.

I can't say 100%, but I broke out horribly after I used this for a few days. I can't say it was definitely this product, but I stopped using it and my face got much better. So sadly I didn't see a difference and I may try again.

This is a great all-in-one serum. It has all the ingredients I was looking for. After only 1 week, I noticed my skin becoming smoother and more hydrated. I use this before my morning skincare routine which includes vitamin C I also use it before I use retinol at night. I let it dry for at least 2 minutes before applying the next product. I took off one star because the nozzle is so short it's hard to get the serum onto your fingertips. Inevitably, some of it drips down the bottle

It's the start of morning and night routine. When I bought my first bottle, it was unclear to me the importance and if it was truly working. After completely using two bottles, I can tell the difference in my texture and glow if I skip this step.

The fact that this serum is under $30 and outperforms serums that are $100+ will never cease to amaze me. Not to mention the amount of product you receive is unreal. This serum does it all and then some. My skin looks and feels so much better within minutes after application. I will never stop repurchasing this product. It's truly incredible.

Nice formulation. Goes on smoothly, leaving a bright, clear skintone. Sinks into skin quickly leaving no tackiness. I really prefer this product compared to other peptide serums I have tried. For reference: I am fair and generally wear sunscreen over the top of any serums. I am easily sensitized, but not with this product. I will be repurchasing.

Going on 3 years of using this morning and night. My skin definitely improved drastically. My routine - led dr dennis gross mask, then this then moisturizer then spf and same at night minus spf and add retinol/ aha alternating nights. I am 35 and according to an app that was very accurate at guessing ages i appear 26-28. This is a huge part of my routine. This must be my 10th bottle. I was about to buy and wanted to post a review first since this is one of the products i find actually worth buying.

I received a deluxe sample of this and used it for a few weeks Love it ao much I bought the full size. It is so hydrating and makes my skin feel good. I love all the benefits and ingredients in one serum. It streamlines my routine. Definitely recommended this!

I originally received this as a birthday present from Ulta last year, and I adored this product so much that I bought a full size the moment my mini was empty. I'm an oily faced woman who will soon be 41, so during the day it's essential that whatever moisturizer I put on my face has to be very light or I'll end up an oil slick. because of this, for many years, I simply skipped moisturizer and went straight for my primer. now that I'm a little older and my face needs that moisturizer step to soften lines, this is absolutely perfect!

avis.titre: I have noticed an improvement in my skin tone.
avis.texte: I first received a sample size of this product for my birthday last year, and was impressed in the change to my skin with minimal use. It feels smoother and healthier, and there is a slight fading of my very significant dark spots. Thank you for the original sample!

Whatever is in this stuff, it is like face crack. Meaning it is addicting. I bought this w very low expectations. And it was on sale for like $17. No lie, this is the best product in my face product arsenal and I have some pricy products. No offense to ordinary, but this is everything it claims to be, or at least for my skin. You wear it under whatever other face products you use, morning, night, whenever. I use primarily at night and noticed more supple looking skin in the morning. And I am exhausted, coming off a few months postpartum. This has been helping me fight the battles known as nightfeedings and sleep deprevation. Yes, I still look tired to a degree, BUT quality of skin is top tier. Get it, worth it. Love it.

avis.titre: I've finished so many bottles of this!
avis.texte: I've finished so many bottles of this peptide serum that I've literally lost count! This is a great, versatile formula, and I've been using it for the past 3 years. I have combination to oily skin and so many products seem too heavy for my skin and make it greasy, or they don't absorb at all. This serum is super lightweight - the consistency is almost like water. My skin drinks it up! It has no funky smells, it's not irritating at all, it plays well with other products, and it's quite affordable. My skin looks a lot more stable, healthier, and refreshed since I incorporated it into my routine. It's a keeper!
This caused me to break out and wasn't noticeably hydrating. Do not understand the hype.

avis.titre: Love it and have purchased it over and over
avis.texte: I LOVE this stuff! I use it as the first step in my skincare regimen after I wash. It absorbs quickly and you don't need a ton of it, so a bottle lasts quite a while. Great value for the money. It's easy to layer under other skincare and under SPF, so I use it morning and night. I am 41 and I've been using this on my face, neck, and the backs of my hands for over a year. During that time, I've noticed my skin looking brighter and more even. I keep repurchasing multiple bottles of this when it goes on sale, just so I don't run out.

This product was wonderful… at first. After a few weeks i began noticing closed comedones. Even with exfoliating and acid treatments they were turning into papules. By month 2 my face was UNRECOGNIZABLE. Ive NEVER had acne in my entire life so I was genuinely confused. I began eliminating products to find the culprit and I IMMEDIATELY saw a difference once eliminating this serum. Now I'll have to spend the next 3 months in recovery 😭 I'm shocked at the positive reviews. STAY AWAY I BEG OF YOU

I loooove this serum! It is truly lightweight, but runs fast down your face so be careful not to get it in your eyes when applying to forehead. It is a great serum, it helps other products sink in, its not heavy, and I have noticed my skin is looking better! You should definitely try this!

avis.titre: Hiding a for of silicone( plastic polymer)
avis.texte: Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer Rating: GOOD Benefits: Hydration Categories: Texture Enhancer, Film-Forming Agent, Polymer Ammonium Acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP Copolymer Description Ammonium acryloyldimethyltaurate/VP copolymer is a synthetic polymer and film-forming agent that also serves to thicken cosmetic formulas. It is used in low amounts in a variety of products due to its stabilizing abilities and esthetically pleasing feel.
This is a no due to Soy oil. I always rash when Soy is in a face product.
Tried a lot if different pepetide serums after Paulas Choice d/c their original peptide serum abd this is the only one I fouhd with comparable results.

After about a week of using this right after toner in my routine, I started to notice that my skin was crazy smooth. I no longer needed my weekly peel to exfoliate dead skin and my pores were looking smaller with no irritation to my sensitive skin. Absolutely recommend.

I really want to gatekeep this product because its so amazing but I won't. I use this day and night and it is so incredible its like 6 steps of a routine in 1 bottle I would almost say its magic. Amazing price point too.
I got this as a free gift and I would buy it. It goes on smooth over my toner and under moisturizer.
After cleanser and toner, I use this before my serums and moisturizer and my skin is like dewy glass at 43 years old. I LOVE this product.

I want to scream from the mountains how amazing the product is. Ive been using it for 4 days and the forehead lines that im so self conscious about have almost disappeared. Visible smoothing and firmer skin….in 4 days. I use this twice a day and use TirTir ceramic cream at night. I am in awe of the improvement of my lines and wrinkles.
47 year old, fair, sun damaged, sensitive skin here, and this stuff made me glow! smooth, hydrated, glowing, glass skin without looking slick. No makeup days are no problem anymore.

I bought this a while ago and keep *trying* to introduce it to my routine because it truly is full of great peptides, but it irritates and breaks me out every time. I'm gonna have to finally give up on it and give it to family.

I've been using this for a few weeks and really like it. I have combination skin, but it loves all the ingredients in this serum. My face looks great and it's helping with my forehead lines. I use it twice a day.
Tried it once and am returning. Instant burning and huge red dots. Immediately needed to wipe it off. I love some other cos rx products like the moisturizer, but not this one!!

i picked a sample size for my birthday gift and used it here and there. at some point i started to be consistent and the results showed! my face looked brighter, firmer, and hydrated. I don't skip this step in my morning or evening routines. The box says to put it on before any other products, but I put it on after my toner. if I use BHA to help clean up pores, I'll also put it on after that. It's a very delicate serum so the BHA will easily cut through it. I wouldn't say I have sensitive skin, but I'm in my late 30's and I'm starting to show signs of aging. I feel like the Peptides help keeps my skin looking juvinated. I love how much you get for the size. I don't feel like I have to skimp out on my application. I like that you get so many benefits in one product. I will use this for the rest of my life. I've even recommended it to my mother.

I've been using this for about a month now and I'm so sad I didn't buy this sooner! By far one of my favorite staples in my skincare routine and I'm a very cystic acne-prone sensitive skin girlie. when I initially started using this, I thought the texture was quite "watery" and I didn't think it would actually hydrate my skin, but I was VERY wrong. Do not let the texture fool you. I use this right after cleansing my skin before I put on my toner, and then follow up with my serums and moisturizer. My skin has never been softer and I definitely think it helped with my makeup not looking cakey or dry. 10/10 highly recommend.

Made my face itchy & I had random red spots in various places on my face after using. I used the gel cleanser, mucin power essence and this immediately after for 5 days straight and experienced the same reaction each day. Not using this brand again

I was given a travel size awhile back and just finished it, let me say my skin has never been clearer! I have oily acne prone skin which has gotten more sensitive over the years (I am over 20). Even though this isn't really its intended purpose I use it similarly to a moisturizer for my night routine, the moisturizers I was using just felt too heavy for me. It has been working for the past two months now so definitely recommend giving it a try!

avis.titre: I will never stop buying this product.
avis.texte: This peptide serum is the ONLY thing that keeps my skin hydrated like actually hydrated. Not just a product that sits on top of your skin and doesn't absorb, this does the work and then some. My skin looks like glass and just feels better with it.
I know skin care is super personal but i had a nad reaction to this, was fine for a few days but then i started breaking out with tiny little bumps :( so sad had to return

I had the mini size first from a trial kit I purchased and I dont know what I was doing with my skin before I got it. It has had a positive effect minimizing pores around my nose and chin. Definitely helps add a brightening/glow effect to my skin. New staple in my routine.

avis.titre: Will always shop at Ulta,for all the Great products!!
avis.texte: Yes,Love this product, got a sample gift for my BIRTHDAY, had to get a bigger bottle 🍾

avis.titre: IM 26 AND LET ME SAY THIS IS WORTH IT!
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin, tried this and im obsessed with how it makes my skin glow!! Im about to buy my seccond bottle and I have recommend to my sister already( only after almost going through the bottle so i can test it out first)… definitely worth the buy!!!

My skin actually likes this product, but after a while, my eyebrows were thinning so i stopped using it and my eyebrows grew back. Then i tried using it again and same thing happened. I stopped again and they grew back. not worth it for me.
Love this serum - have been using it twice a day for a while now and I like how it makes my skin feel hydrated and bright.

avis.titre: i wish i could love this
avis.texte: the claims were promising as well as reviews. i got it and used to for weeks and had no difference. pretty disappointing, i wish it worked since i like other things from cosrx.
I told myself I'd come back on here to leave a review after 6 weeks. I have definitely noticed a difference in my skin. My face looks good! So it definitely does work

Lots of product for the price. I have other brands that are more concentrated. It's been ok do far I have very sensitive skin. It did burn a little spot on my face so do not use over acne or ingrown hairs.

I really love this product! I've been using it for a couple of weeks and I Can already feel my skin looks better and healthier. I will for sure buy this product again and I would totally recommend it.

Wow! This product is amazing. I have sensitive skin and had zero reaction to this product. In fact, this feels so very soothing on the skin. It is a wonderful texture, perhaps like a slippery thick water. It is not at all sticky ans absorbs well. I used it twice a day and it worked well under moisturizers and makeup. Using this i noticed fine lines decreased, texture very noticeably smoothed out, skin stayed plump and firm. Oil and dryness seems balanced. Will repurchase this one!
Can tell a huge difference in my skin using this serum! Helps with lines and firmness.

avis.titre: Combo skin girly- A GAME CHANGER! < 3
avis.texte: After using only a few times, I noticed my skin was looking and feeling so smooth- like i have a smoothening filter irl. and realized it was cause of this!! that's coming from someone who has kept it very simple. I do my Cerave facewash, THIS, snail mucin, and moisturize with Torriden which also has hylauronic acid (look into how it pairs great w snail mucin) and Y'ALLL it literally gives me that glass skin look. So shocked. I want to assume the bad reviews are due to using other products that have harsh ingredients that may clash with this or something? redgardless everyone's skin is different. it's a lightweight, watery product. WORTH A TRY especially pairing it with snail mucin after!

I wondered if this product actually worked on my skin, because I usually wear Dior, Shiseido, Lancome Absolue serums and creams. Then I travelled for 2 months with everything but this one specifically. Not even a week later, I lost my "glass skin" youthful look. Now I am absolutely in love with KBeauty!!! I will just finish the ones I have today (after using years) and stop wasting $ on things that are expensive but "okay". This is my favorite skin care step now.

I simply cannot say enough good things about this serum. It's waterlike texture sinks right in hydrate,plumps and protects skin. It's a must have if you suffer from Dyshidrotic eczema. With flare-ups I typically do 5-6 pumps in my hands rub them together then apply an occlusive.
I have rosacea and usually the CosRX products actually help my rosacea, but the combination of actives in this product has my skin red, inflamed, and painful. Avoid if you have rosacea.

I got a sample of this first and ended up falling in love so bought the full bottle. I apply this after my toner and it adds so much hydration to the face. I put 4-5 pumps in my hand and pat it on my face for 20-30 seconds then I repeat once more. I don't think it's going to cure any skin issues but it truly adds a healthy glowy look and feel to the skin.

I love this! I got to try this when I chose it as my birthday reward. After using it consistently for a whole month, my skin has obtained natural glow and improved acne issues! This is amazing and I was really impressed especially with sensitive skin.
I can't say exactly what this is doing but my skin is happier when I use it. It retains moisture better, resists irritation, and just behaves. I will keep using this until they stop making it.

I will be purchasing again. This product has a great price point and actually works. After application, my skin feels good. My skin is very sensitive so I was delighted that I had no break outs or irritation.

This is great for my lazy days when I just need to get myself out the door and don't have time for my five step routine. I'll just use this and sunscreen. Peptides are kinda hard to fit into my routine since I like to use AHA/BHAs. And they also don't play with benzyl peroxide so just something to note when using. Ill also use this in my night routine w/ retinol and so far no reaction. I happy with this product. I heard this also plays well with vitamin C. I use THD vitamin c so hopefully it's gentle enough to work with the peptides and not break me out lol.

avis.titre: I am in Love with this skincare line!
avis.texte: The Best product I have used in years. Highly recommend this product to EVERYONE!

had smooth, soft and clear skin aside from the occasional hormone pimple, and this gave me horrible texture. entire face has raised bumps, all over my throat and ears and red splotches. made my skin feel sticky after application despite having very watery texture. boyfriend used it and had no reaction, helped even out his skin pigmentation.
I used to use regular hyaluronic acid after cleansing but have upgraded my serum step to this product. I really like it and feel that it revitalizes my skin noticeably.

I received this as a birthday gift. This was my first time using a product using hyaluranic acid. I never saw any difference after two months of daily use. Plus, there was a sticky residue after each use.

As someone who has combo skin, I really enjoy layering lightweight products instead of using thick creams and serums. This serum I immediately noticed hydration and plump to the skin the next day. My fine lines near my mouth and in forehead less noticable. Its so light and my skin drinks it up. Paired with my gel moisturizer I feel like its the perfect skincare combination for my combo skin type as we enter summer.

Im absolutely in love with this product! Ive been using it for a couple of months. My texture has gotten more smooth and my dark spots lighten up. I made sure to follow the instructions on the packaging. It works too good! Will be a permanent staple in my skincare routine :3

I got this serum ss a sample and had to purchase the full size. Its pretty "thin" as far as serums go, basically like water liquid consistency, but it goes onto skin and absorbs quickly. I just purchased the full size!
I originally received this as a birthday sample and fell in love! My face looks so clear, hydrated and smooth and my makeup has never looked so clean. Cannot recommend enough!

I put this on first after cleaning my face, wait about a minute then apply all other creams and serums. I definitely notice a difference in skin texture after just a free weeks. The price is very reasonable.
I added this product to my skinncare routine and my skin is well hydrated and no breakouts.
First things first, I'm so sensitive and this gave me no trouble at all. My acne has significantly improved. My pores aren't clogging up and overall my face feels moisturized and supple!

I chose this product as one of my free birthday rewards for March. I'm so glad I did because it truly has improved my skin after the first use! I HIGHLY recommend this! I definitely recommend using after you cleanse your face and before using any serums or moisturizer. OR you can really just use this product and it makes your skin feel great, no lie🙌🏼
It's hydrating without being too heavy. Makes my face feel soft stressed and absorbs pretty fast.
It's hydrating without being too heavy. Makes my face feel soft stressed and absorbs pretty fast.

avis.titre: Broke me out and made me oily :(
avis.texte: I was really disappointed with this product :( it completely broke me out and had my face so oily it felt drenched.

avis.titre: I've tried a lot of things and this works
avis.texte: I've struggled with skin care my entire life and I've been using this for six weeks. I can report that my adult acne has cleared up. My skin tone has evened out. Although I still have red in my cheeks I feel like it has cleared some in my forehead and chin. My pores arent as pronounced.

Used this three times after receiving for my Ulta birthday gift. I had immediate breakouts with this (I use Aklief for acne, so it is very under control). This was the only product introduced to my skin, so it was very obviously the culprit. Will not be using again—too bad, because I was very excited about this for my more mature skin.

I have very dry skin, and this makes it look and feel less dry. I use several layers of it. It's has a watery consistency, so it absorbs pretty quickly. It makes my fine lines less visible, and my skin feels less tight.

This product didn't really do much for my skin, personally. It's a nice light texture, but for me it didn't add anything into my routine to boost my current products and skin. I won't be repurchasing. I suppose it would be a good purchase if you want a lightweight moisture boost.
At first i was surprised by the texture and consistency. But I've grown to absolutely love it. This before the snail mucin is a dream combo!! And under makeup…..*chef's Kiss* 1000% recommend

this product has been awesome & i havent really had much luck with cosrx before. the snail mucin stuff broke me out, but THIS is that girl. my combination, acne prone & acne scarred skin is loving this stuff. i can already tell a huge difference after 2 weeks.
Received as a birthday gift. I love CosRX products and use several daily. This product felt good on my skin. It leaves a slight tackiness. Overall i like it.
I loved it from the first application, you can feel your face different, I would buy it and buy it and buy it again
One of the worst skincare products I have ever tried it burned my skin and made it irritated red and inflamed.

I received this in a sample size as my birtbday gift and ive been thoroughly inpressed! Perfect for people who like a simple skincare routine with minimal steps. I'll definitely be buying a full size!
I didnt want to like this item, but ut turned out really great. Love the way my skin looks and feels, it's an added bonus to my skincare.

avis.titre: LOVE the product, hate the packaging
avis.texte: Absolutely LOVE this product. Only a small amount is necessary, so the bottle lasts a while. The only thing I can't stand is the packaging, mainly just the dispenser. It should be in a dropper due to how watery the formula is, not a pump.

I have never left a review before now. I tried this as a "free birthday gift" from ulta. At first, i thought my skin felt super soft and thought i may have found a new product. Then within 5 min..the redness began. Then burning, then severe itching. I immediately went to wash my face thoroughly. 3 bendadryls later and ice packs the swelling, redness, burning and itching began to subside. I am not quite sure what I'm allergic to in this. But people with sensitive skin should be very cautious about using this.
I've been using this product consistently every night for the past two weeks & can already see the improvement. My skin looks more clear and is not as red.

I have dry skin and this didn't seem to do much of anything for my face. I did find another use for it though. I use it in my body out of the shower, let is absorb for a few minutes and then apply body lotion. It seems to work better for my body.

I LOVE this product! I first tried it as a sample and haven't put it down since! It works great with my other skin care, leaves my very oily skin feeling hydrated and not oiled like some serums will! My skin is baby soft and feels firm! The back of my hands get very dry during the harsh winter months, this product has done a 180 on them! A little goes a long way, I use this twice a day and haven't had any issues whatsoever!
Recieved rhe sample for my Bday gift and i am loving it! Purchasing a bottle as we speak! My skin looks brighter, more firm and less breakouts! Def recommend!
Recieved rhe sample for my Bday gift and i am loving it! Purchasing a bottle as we speak! My skin looks brighter, more firm and less breakouts! Def recommend!

Was using this like a toner. Wrong. By day 10 my face was burning. However I stopped using it for 5 days and now only use it couple times a week. If you have sensitive skin, your skin will need to slowly adjust. Does work though.

avis.titre: I will buy this again and again.
avis.texte: It's a fantastic product. It plays well with all my other skin care. It has made a difference in the size of my pores in just a few days of using it.I LOVE it!!!

This product is LITERALLY like a genie in a bottle. I was using pure hylauronic acid for my skin care and it was alright and did its job. When I switched to this product, oh my goodness it changed my skin so much. My texture and pores were so minimal it was crazy and my skin was SOO bouncy. I have dry/very oily skin so I tend to lean towards more simple, hydrating products. This was it!! I also live in a very hot, dry area and this did not make me more oily than I already am. Put your pennies in a jar and buy this!!
This stuff is a skin game changer. It leaves the skin so soft and minimizes pores. It is non-greasy and you can use multiple layers without issue.

I got this product as a free birthday gift and immediately noticed my skin is smoother i have only been using it for 3 days and i use bio oil as a moisterizer to reduce dark spots. I have very sensitive dry skin but so far i have had no reaction to the product besides smoother skin after reading some comments I definetly recommended doing a patch skin test.

I've been using this product for around 4 months now. Not a huge difference in my skin when using it every night. One thing I did notice right away was if I used more than two pumps it would lead to irritation. Nothing big just slight itchiness and I kept using it. Except within the last week I've went from slight itchiness to a full blown rash up and down my neck and at the base of the jawline from this product alone (I start my skincare on my neck and move up to my face). I read the lower reviews and looked over the ingredients prior to purchasing thinking it couldn't be that bad well it's bad lol.

I got this as my birthday free gift this month and immediately went and got the full size because this is a NEED. My skin has never looked and felt this good in awhile. Complete confidence boost! I wish they allowed picture reviews cause the picture would make you buy it ;)

I really like this product. It is supposed to be used before serums, moisturizer, etc., and it gives your skin a good amount of peptides, which are very important for anti aging routines. It is liquidity, which i like, as it absorbs right in your skin. I would have given it 5 starts however, sometimes it feels a little like it is burning my skin, but this is rare, and i have really sensitive skin, so of my skin is acting up, I just skip it that day or night.

I have always had some kind of texture around my cheeks and after using this for less than a month my skin is so smooth i cannot believe it! It looks so glowy literally glass skin. If you are thinking about buying it please do!

avis.titre: I'm sold! This stuff is amazing...
avis.texte: I purchased a cleanser and this was added as a gift with purchase. I had no interest in using until after I tried. Wow! I feel like I'm using cool water on my face. It hydrates so well. I am almost 60, but I swear this stuff makes my skin look 15-20 years younger. I use under eye, tap all over face and even on the backs of my hands. I have spent a lot (and I mean a lot) of money trying to find something that really works. It's funny that I 'found' it by using a freebie. I'm purchasing for myself today and for my daughter as well. Even my son-in-law wants to use it! Be consistent and you should get the same result I did. Beauty supplies are very expensive, so I would not write this or encourage others to try unless I really felt it was worth it. I am not an influencer or getting anything for this review. I just really love this stuff. I pray they don't discontinue!!!!
This product burned my skin the first time I used it. I have never had that reaction before, so I do not recommend.

Since I started using the retinaldehyde by The Ordinary, it usually makes my skin look peely and not pretty. I began using this prior to my Vit C serum on alternating nights and my skin looks far healthier and not like a lizard! I've already used this on my heels prior to a thick cream after showering and it works great for that, too! I think this will always be in my arsenal from now on!
I have combo, textured skin, and this product controlled my oil and provided so much moisture. Everything it says it does, it does!
My face was smooth overnight. Also used on my hands for the same result

avis.titre: win for oily acne prone dehydrated skin!
avis.texte: I'm an esthi and this has easily become a favorite in my routine, my skin feels soft , hydrated, fine lines less visible with the peptides that are in the serum, it is very calming and soothing as well. Highly recommend !

avis.titre: Love this as part of my daily skincare!
avis.texte: I received a sample of this in one of the 'free gifts with purchase' and fell in love (as I tend to with a lot of samples). I liked it so much that I purchased the full size when my sample was gone. It's hydrating and improved my skin texture. I also noticed a reduction in my fine lines, although I am using several new products so I can't be certain this alone is affecting this. Definitely recommend!
I had a hotrible allergic reaction, I always wear COSRX, it's an amazing brand but this prodict in specific has other quemicals that can be harsh on the skin. Careful with this product

Im a 20 year old with skin so dull and dry that i look 5-10 years older than I am. I used this one time and instantly my skin was rejuvenated back to a youthful look. Im on my second day of using this and it has made my skin look so good that I look like I am wearing makeup. In addition, my dark undereyes have visibly lightened (probably due to the intense hydration that this product provides). I used this in combination with glycolic acid as a toner, then this product as a serum, and then I applied a thick B5 moisturizer on top of this to seal in its hydrating abilities. If this product does not work for you, i would highly recommend: 1. Wash face with your fav (for me a gentle cleansing balm) 2.) Apply a toner (for me either the aha/bha from cosrx or glycolic acid because these help my pores) 3.) This product 4.) **A thick moisturizer that holds in moisture (for me a B5 cream)** *Tip: only introduce 1 or 2 new products at a time or your skin will react negatively* Even if you are an oily girly, i think this product could still benefit you because it is not heavy. It is thin like water but packs a punch. For dry girlies like me, add a moisturizer on top to keep it sealed in. No, this review is not paid. I am just so happy and do not want cosrx to change this or get rid of it. I need a stockpile.
